ops.text: (k) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 where Garman processes Sparkling data; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. Garman shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance undertaking as a new General Matters sub-clause, since the Agreement contains none even though Garman personnel perform installation, data conversion and support involving our data and premises; the covenant now runs for the term only. These are our standard limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M); we can discuss E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if Garman's current program is lower.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause in General Matters

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2M.
Cyber and privacy insurance of USD 5M for vendors processing Customer Data.
Workers' compensation as required by law.
